topic: Comparing Car Insurance Quotes on the Phone

script.title: ON THE INSURANCE CALL
script.story_hook: Two quotes, one phone, a seventeen dollar gap.
script.intro_zh: 兩份報價、一支電話、十七元的差距。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a phone call about car insurance. Listen for polite words that compare quotes.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到一通關於汽車保險的電話。留意客氣又實用的比價說法。
script.outro: That's a quote compared the calm way. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 報價就這樣從容地比完了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: It's time to read along line by line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一句一句輪流跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a heavyset man in his early forties with a bald head and a short salt-and-pepper beard, a navy quarter-zip fleece over a grey undershirt, plaid work trousers, and wide reading glasses on a gold chain
script.char_b_description: a bright-eyed young woman in her late twenties with honey blonde hair in a neat low bun, a slim black headset over one ear, a white blouse with one rolled sleeve, and a small name badge

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, hello, I'm comparing car insurance, want a quote.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ hɛˈloʊ aɪm kæmˈpɛrɪŋ ˈkɑɹ ɪnˈʃʊɹəns wɑnt ə ˈkwoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 喂，你好，我在比較汽車保險，想要一份報價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we can do this in fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wi kæn du ðɪs ɪn ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，我們十五分鐘就能聊完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, I just poured the coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪ dʒʌst pɔɹd ðə ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我的咖啡才剛倒好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All right, let me find your vehicle, what's the address?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈɹaɪt lɛt mi ˈfaɪnd jɔɹ ˈviɪkəl wʌts ðə əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我查一下你的車，地址是哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ohio, Cleveland, four-oh-two East Thirteenth Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈhaɪoʊ ˈklivlənd ˈfoɹ oʊ ˈtu ˈist θɜˈtin ˈstɹit/
dialogue.zh: 俄亥俄州，克利夫蘭，東十三街四零二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, it sits under your brother-in-law.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaʊnd ɪt ɪt sɪts ˈʌndɚ jɔɹ ˈbrʌðɚɪn ˌlɔ/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，目前登記在你姐夫名下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, he helped buy it, so his name is there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi hɛlpt ˈbaɪ ɪt soʊ hɪz ˈneɪm ɪz ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，當初是他幫忙買的，所以登記在他名下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Who drives the car these days?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt hu ˈdɹaɪvz ðə ˈkɑɹ ðiz ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那現在主要是誰在開？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly me, he takes the subway now and then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli mi hi ˈteɪks ðə ˈsʌbˌweɪ ˈnaʊ ænd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 主要是我開，他偶爾搭一下地鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, and your license is Nebraska, correct?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ænd jɔɹ ˈlaɪsəns ɪz nəˈbræskə kɚˈɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 好，你的駕照寫的是內布拉斯加，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's the new card from last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə ˈnu ˈkɑɹd fɹəm ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，上個月剛換的新卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, the system checks across states.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ðə ˈsɪstəm ˈtʃɛks əˈkɹɔs ˈsteɪts/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，系統會做跨州的比對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that change the rate much?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈɹeɪt mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那會影響保費多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, as long as your address matches, you're fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ əz ˈlɔŋ æz jɔɹ əˈdɹɛs ˈmætʃəz jʊɹ ˈfaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不會，只要申報的地址一致就沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so, what kind of coverage should I pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ wʌt ˈkaɪnd əv ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ ʃʊd aɪ ˈpɪk/
dialogue.zh: 好。那，我該選哪種保障？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, liability versus full coverage, let's talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˌlaɪəbɪˈlɪɾi ˈvɝsəs ˈfʊl ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ lɛts ˈtɔk/
dialogue.zh: 我們來聊聊責任險和全險的差別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, liability, that fixes the other car, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˌlaɪəbɪˈlɪɾi ðæt ˈfɪksəz ði ˈʌðɚ ˈkɑɹ ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，責任險就是修對方的車，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and if the crash is yours, it repairs theirs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪf ðə kɹæʃ ɪz jɔɹz ɪt rɪˈpɛɹz ðɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 對，萬一是你撞的，它負責修對方的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And full coverage also protects my own car?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈfʊl ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ ˈɔlsoʊ pɹəˈtɛkts maɪ ˈoʊn ˈkɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那全險還會保護我自己的車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, plus collisions, theft, and storm damage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt plʌs kəˈlɪʒənz θɛft ænd stɔɹm ˈdæmɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，碰撞、失竊、天災都在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I owe on the car, so they require full.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊ ɑn ðə ˈkɑɹ soʊ ðeɪ rɪˈkwaɪɹ ˈfʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我的車貸還沒清掉，所以貸款方要求全險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, loan means full coverage is required.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd ˈloʊn minz ˈfʊl ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ ɪz rɪˈkwaɪɚd/
dialogue.zh: 了解，有貸款就一定要全險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Now, about the deductible... what's that again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ əˈbaʊt ðə ˌdɛdəˈsɪtʃəbl wʌts ðət əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好。那免賠額…那是什麼來著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's what you pay yourself before we pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wʌt ju ˈpeɪ jɔɹˈsɛlf bɪˈfɔɹ wi ˈpeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是出事故時，你自己先付的那筆錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a higher deductible means a lower bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə ˈhaɪɚ ˌdɛdəˈsɪtʃəbl ˈminz ə ˈloʊɚ bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 所以免賠額越高，每月的帳單越低？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, and one thousand dollars is the best value.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɚˈɛkt ænd wʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɑləɚz ɪz ðə ˈbɛst ˈvæljʊ/
dialogue.zh: 正確，選一千美元那一檔最划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have money saved, so aim high for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈmʌnɪ seɪvd soʊ ˈeɪm ˈhaɪ fɔɹ mi/
dialogue.zh: 我有存錢，所以往高檔選就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever. What monthly payment feels okay to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvɚ wʌt ˈmʌnθli ˈpeɪmənt filz oʊˈkeɪ tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那每月付多少你覺得輕鬆？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around one ten, never over one twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɹaʊnd wʌn ˈtɛn ˈnɛvɚ ˈoʊvɚ wʌn ˈtwɛnɾi/
dialogue.zh: 大概一百一，絕對不要超過一百二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full coverage, thousand-dollar deductible, one sec.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʊl ˈkʌvɚɪdʒ ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɑləɚ ˌdɛdəˈsɪtʃəbl wʌn ˈsɛk/
dialogue.zh: 好，全險、一千元免賠額…我算一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more, um, does the added sound system count?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ ʌm dʌz ði ˈædəd ˈsaʊnd ˈsɪstəm kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 再問一件，嗯，車裡加裝的音響要算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can add an equipment note, ten dollars more.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn æd ən ɪˈkwɪpmənt noʊt tɛn ˈdɑləɚz mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 可以加一條設備項目，每月多十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skip it, the old owner put that in.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ɪt ði ˈoʊld ˈoʊnɚ ˈpʊt ðæt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那算了，音響是前車主裝的，不是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, standard gear, no extra line.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈstændɚd ɡɪɹ noʊ ˈɛkstɹə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那就算標配，不加那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, one more about other drivers.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wʌn mɔɹ əˈbaʊt ˈʌðɚ ˈdɹaɪvɚz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，還有其他駕駛的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, you mentioned someone else drives.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ju ˈmɛnʃənd ˈsʌmwʌn ɛls ˈdɹaɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 啊，你剛剛提到還有別人會開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brother-in-law borrows it sometimes, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðɚɪnˌlɔ ˈbɹoʊz ɪt ˈsʌmtaɪmz oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我姐夫偶爾會借車開一下，那樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He must be listed if he drives twice a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi məst bi ˈlɪstɪd ɪf hi ˈdɹaɪvz twaɪs ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 他每週開兩次以上，就要登記進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe once a week, let's leave him out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wʌns ə ˈwik lɛts liv hɪm ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 大概一週一次，那就不登記他了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, but call us first if that changes.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bʌt ˈkɔl ʌs fɝst ɪf ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過情況若有變，要先打給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Are there any discounts I should ask for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ɑr ðɛɹ ˈɛni ˈdɪskaʊnts aɪ ʃʊd æsk ˈfɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 明白。那有什麼折扣是我該問的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, twenty-five less with the safety pack, want it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ˈtwɛnɾi faɪv lɛs wɪð ðə ˈseɪfli pæk wɑnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有的，加安全包每月減二十五，要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What exactly is inside that safety pack?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðæt ˈseɪfli pæk/
dialogue.zh: 那個安全包裡面到底有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roadside rescue, plus one free ride home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹoʊdˌsaɪd ˈɹɛskju plʌs wʌn ˈfɹi ɹaɪd hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 道路救援，還有一次免費代叫車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds nice, but I already have rescue membership.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz naɪs bʌt aɪ ɔlˈɛdi hæv ˈɹɛskju mɛmbɚˌʃɪp/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來不錯，但我已經有救援會員了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it won't help, I won't push it on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt woʊnt hɛlp aɪ woʊnt pʊʃ ɪt ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 那對你沒用，我就不硬推了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Hey, I also own a house with insurance.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks heɪ aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ oʊn ə ˈhaʊs wɪθ ɪnˈʃʊɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。對了，我也有房子，還有房屋保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which company? Bundling is often cheaper.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈkʌmpəni ˈbʌndlɪŋ ɪz ˈɔfənz ˈtʃipɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哪一家公司？合併投保常常比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: State Farm, renewed last year, still fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪt ˈfɑɹm rɪˈnuld læst jɪɹ stɪl ˈfɹɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 州立農業，去年剛續過，還在效期內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add the bundle discount, then read the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd ðə ˈbʌndəl ˈdɪskaʊnt ðɛn rid ðə ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我把合併折扣算進去，然後唸數字給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, ready for the number now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈɹɛdi fɔɹ ðə ˈnʌmbɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我準備好聽價格了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bundled, it's one hundred four. Alone, one twenty-one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌndəld ɪts wʌn ˈhʌndɹɪd fɔɹ əˈloʊn wʌn ˈtwɛnɾi wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 合併後一百零四，分開則要一百二十一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventeen dollars... my wife could bundle too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvəntɪn ˈdɑləɚz maɪ ˈwaɪf kʊd ˈbʌndəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 差十七元…我太太的保單說不定也能合併。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could bundle her policy with this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊd ˈbʌndəl hɜ ˈpɑləsi wɪð ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把她那份也一起合併。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes it cheaper. Why did I never ask sooner?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks ɪt ˈtʃipɚ waɪ dɪd aɪ ˈnɛvɚ æsk ˈsuːnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣反而更便宜。我為什麼不早一點問？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because most people never ask about bundling.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈkɑz moʊst ˈpipəl ˈnɛvɚ æsk əˈbaʊt ˈbʌndlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 因為多數人從來沒想到要問合併。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. Can I take a few days?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɛɹ kæn aɪ ˈteɪk ə ˈfju ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，合理。我能多想幾天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The quote stays good for fourteen days, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkwoʊt steɪz ɡʊd fɔɹ ˌfɔɹˈtin ˈdeɪz noʊ ˈɹʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 報價會保留十四天，價格不變，不用趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, send the quote, I'll call you back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt sɛnd ðə ˈkwoʊt aɪl kɔl ju bæk/
dialogue.zh: 完美，把報價傳給我，我看完就回電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I'll email it, take care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs aɪl ˈimeɪl ɪt ˈteɪk ˈkɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我馬上寄給你，再見。

script.youtube_title: 【汽車保險比價☎️】「往高檔選就對了」💰🚗｜聽完敢自己打給保險公司｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Car Insurance Quotes
script.youtube_title_en: "Aim High for Me" — Comparing Car Insurance Quotes on the Phone
script.youtube_description:
「往高檔選就對了」——第一次自己打電話問汽車保險報價，怎麼聽懂那些陌生詞？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就是一通打給保險客服中心的電話。

你會聽到：報地址查出車子是掛在誰名下、說清誰才是主要駕駛；責任險與全險的差別用兩句話聽懂；免賠額越高帳單越低的選擇邏輯；加裝音響算不算設備、姐夫偶爾借車要不要登記；還有安全包推銷怎麼禮貌拒絕、房屋保險合併之後省下十七元的意外收穫。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人講電話的真實語感：um、oh、got it、right。聽完你就會用：want a quote、What's that again、Are there any discounts、Let's leave him out。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓耳朵先熟，嘴巴自然跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱與按小鈴鐺，下次比價不吃虧。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Aim high for me" — what do you actually say on the first call to compare car insurance quotes? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice, taken as one real phone call to an insurance service center.

You will hear: giving the address so the agent pulls up the car, naming the real driver, liability versus full coverage in two plain sentences, choosing a higher deductible for a lower bill, whether an added sound system counts, when a brother-in-law must be listed, politely declining a safety pack, and a seventeen-dollar win from bundling home insurance.

Everything stays A2-level with natural phone speech: um, oh, got it, right. By the end you'll own lines like want a quote, Are there any discounts, and Let's leave him out.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
